welcome.title: Welcome to GH Mobile+
welcome.message: Triage notifications, review pull requests, and keep up with your repositories from your phone.
install.title: Add it to your Home Screen
install.message: The installed app opens full screen and starts faster.
install.ios.share: Tap the Share button in Safari’s toolbar.
install.ios.add: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen.”
install.ios.open: Open GH Mobile+ from your Home Screen.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.message: GH Mobile+ calls GitHub directly from your device. The sign-in relay only exchanges and refreshes tokens, and stores nothing. Your session stays on this device.
setup.title: Optional settings
setup.message: You can change these anytime in Settings.
setup.lock.title: App lock
setup.lock.unavailable: This device doesn’t offer a screen lock to the browser.
setup.lock.failed: App lock wasn’t turned on. Try again, or skip it for now.
setup.badge.title: Unread count on the app icon
setup.badge.message: Shows your unread notification count while the app is open. Requires notification permission.
setup.badge.turnOn: Turn on unread count on the app icon
setup.badge.isOn: Unread count on the app icon is on
